entries.summary: Dissect faster with medical skill, fine-cutting tools, and helpers, and dissect every eligible corpse in corpse-loot zones.
details: Dissection time now depends on First Aid, perception, dexterity, fine-cutting quality, and up to three nearby crafting helpers.
The zone activity menu gains Dissect corpses with automatic fine-cutting tool fetching, and followers can be ordered to dissect through dialogue without claiming the same corpse.
known_limits: The activity-specific reality-bubble shrink from the donor is not included because 0.G keeps fixed-size map caches.
